description: Operational bibliography roles for frozen entry evidence, contextual connectors, typed headings, and structured block decoding.

BIB_HEADER.definition: The overall heading introducing a bibliography or references region.

BIB_SUBHEADER.definition: An internal language, source, period, or category heading connecting bibliography regions.

CONTINUATION.definition: Citation content broken across lines or too incomplete to establish an entry alone.

ENTRY.definition: A recognizable bibliographic record that supplies independent entry evidence.

FILLER.definition: Non-citation layout or extraction material included only between supported bibliography evidence.

NON_BIB_HEADER.definition: A heading for document material outside the bibliography; it terminates growth in the direction encountered.

OTHER.definition: Ordinary material that is not one of the operational bibliography roles.

UNKNOWN.definition: Insufficient evidence or unresolved reviewer disagreement; never a prediction target.

boundary_flags.HARD_STOP: A trusted line or physical gap that must terminate block growth.
boundary_flags.SOFT_STOP: Evidence against growth that remains contextual.

label_statuses.ADJUDICATED: A trusted resolution based on preserved independent review evidence.
label_statuses.PROVISIONAL: A deterministic or model-derived bootstrap label; never independent evaluation truth.
label_statuses.SINGLE_REVIEW: One contextual review; eligible for development diagnostics only.
label_statuses.UNRESOLVED: Disagreement or insufficient evidence; masked from supervised losses.

invariants: The frozen entry classifier and original regional label are immutable.
Only ENTRY may seed a bibliography block.
BIB_HEADER is included and terminates upward growth.
BIB_SUBHEADER connects independently supported bibliography regions.
NON_BIB_HEADER remains outside and terminates growth in the direction encountered.
CONTINUATION and FILLER may attach but never seed.
UNKNOWN and unresolved examples are masked from every supervised loss.
